node.title: Constant-weight shortening cap for FPC5 GRS shells
node.statement: Every fixed FPC5 GRS syndrome shell injects through locator support into a binary constant-weight code of length N, weight w=min(d,N-d), and distance at least 2 sigma, where sigma=H-d and H=t ell for u<0 while H=d+ell for a fixed required-background chart. After fixing any j common support coordinates, the residual weight is x=w-j. If x<sigma the shortened family is singleton; if Delta_j=x^2-(N-j)(x-sigma)>0, Plotkin-Johnson gives P_j=floor((N-j)sigma/Delta_j). Hence the original chart has size at most floor(binom(N,j)P_j/binom(w,j)). For u>=0 the complete fixed source/touched/degree cell is at most binom(b,u) times this cap; for u<0 there is one chart.
